newsitem.title: USA: SunAmerica, NBC Sports in programming deal.
newsitem.headline: SunAmerica, NBC Sports in programming deal.

text.p: SunAmerica Inc on Friday said it has entered into a multi-year programming partnership with General Electric's NBC Sports, to begin in early April.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

The retirement savings firm said that in the first twelve months of the pact, SunAmerica-sponsored sports features and advertisements will run more than 230 times in conjunction with NBC events such as Wimbledon and the Baseball World Series.
Sports updates called "the SunAmerica NBC Sports Desk" will air, while displaying a SunAmerica Logo.

Further, SunAmerica will unveil a new advertising campain in April during NBC's telecast of the NBA basketball playoff. In the fall, NBC will air the "SunAmerica NFL Post-Game Report" after football games aired by the network.
